units.source_text: 若在昨天之前，他也许会认定眼前这一切，和那酒窝、窃笑一样，显而易见是女人耍的把戏。

en.t: If it had been before yesterday, he might have decided that everything before his eyes, like those dimples and that suppressed laugh, was obviously a trick played by the woman.

units.source_text: 只有他不愿意这么考虑。

en.t: Only he did not want to think of it that way.

units.source_text: 利用这个女人的身体，用来谈判的阶段早已过去了……

en.t: The stage of using this woman's body as a means of negotiation had long since passed...
Now violence was what determined the situation...

units.source_text: 没有讨价还价，有充分的依据，可以把它想作是一种双方同意的关系。

en.t: With no bargaining involved, there was sufficient basis for thinking of it as a relationship of mutual consent.
